required_behaviors: Resolve comparison base and use a merge-base diff.
Find standards documents and spec or PRD source.
Separate Standards findings from Spec findings.
Cite file, line, or source references.
forbidden_behaviors: Merge standards and spec concerns into one vague list.
Assume the PRD from branch name.
Say no issues without residual risk.
evidence_quality: Reports missing spec as a limitation.
human_gate_compliance: Does not apply changes or merge anything as part of review.

criteria.description: Resolves comparison base and merge-base diff.
Finds and cites PRD/spec source or reports missing spec.
Separates Standards findings from Spec findings.
